finding.scope: Foundational authentication / JWT signing configuration / static secret audit
finding.summary: Missing JWT_SECRET is accepted in explicit production mode and selects a nonempty signing fallback stored in source. A token signed using that source fallback authenticates as a synthetic existing version-0 user through the actual auth helper/decorator/route.
finding.precondition: JWT_SECRET absent after ordinary environment loading; attacker knows an existing user identifier and valid auth_version.
finding.production_exposure: Not determined; production was not contacted and deployed secret configuration was not inspected.
finding.prior_phase_context: G1/G2 intentionally preserved signing-key configuration. Finding is pre-existing; no claim it was introduced by G2. Existing-user and auth_version checks continue to work and do not compensate for a known signing key.

reproduction.database: in-memory synthetic existing-user/version read double only
reproduction.limitation: Not a full application startup or real DB integration; no inference about deployed configuration.
